main_decision: Do not build a spatial cross-fit/covariance-cancel output estimator from the presently available evidence. No observable invariant supplied by these captures identifies true physical correction separately from shared source/P error under arbitrary RGB/spatial/time covariance. One optional intervention diagnostic below measures conditional input sensitivity only; it is deferred, not scheduled and cannot solve that ambiguity.
assumption_gap_proof: Let all observed source/guide/geometry/control trajectories be fixed, C be observed RGB, P=F(C) the frozen causal pilot, and T_j the measured native responses in contexts j. Choose any small valid signed coherent field H with C-H still admissible radiance. WorldA has clean signal C and no source error; WorldB has clean signal C-H and shared source error H. The unknown correlation of that error with guides/time is allowed by the present evidence.

All F(C), serialized native inputs, T_j(P), T_j(C), null repeats and any perturbations constructed from those observable inputs can be identical in both worlds. Their physical correctness differs. An estimator receiving only these inputs therefore returns the same image in both worlds and cannot guarantee preserving WorldA detail while removing WorldB error. This is an identification counterexample, not a claim that either world describes the game.

More same-input native contexts expose sample context variability. They do not create new independent source measurements or reveal the shared clean signal. The material same-P cohort's mature context-scatter fraction0.244619% and wave's zero scatter describe those cohorts only; context averaging cannot remove the component common to P and all responses.

Known correlation structure, a separately justified independent sensor/path sample, calibrated physical transport or another external identification restriction would change the problem. Current pixel partitions, RNG identifiers, native repeats and low measured correlation do not supply such a restriction.
spatial_cross_fit_review: Disjoint training/validation pixels can prevent literal reuse of a held-out pixel in one fitted pilot coefficient. They do not prove independent errors: a spatially shared field survives every partition, colored/AR noise can couple them, and the native operator may couple regions nonlocally.

The frozen harmonic model already uses a source training mask, but its full-source sigma includes validation pixels and its second atom reuses the partition adaptively. Another same-frame mask is not automatically a new independent pilot or native covariance estimator.

A shared source perturbation may produce the same physical atom on both masks, giving apparently stable coefficients without revealing whether it is signal or bias. Native T(P) is endogenous to that estimated P. Source fit covariance cannot be reused as D=P-T(P) uncertainty.

A production response-conditioned fit can also change native B/D covariance. Regressing an output against B to force apparent cancellation would fit the test itself and is excluded. No response confidence, IID effective count or unobserved covariance is introduced.

exact_cancellation_negative_controls.tied_response_identity: For P=C and the SAME measured response T(P)=B, B+P-T(P)=C algebraically, with the prescribed operation order/dtype. This requires no clean truth and is a control of pairing/application, not evidence that C is clean.
exact_cancellation_negative_controls.independent_context_qualification: If the identical input uses a different response Bprime, output=C+(B-Bprime). That mismatch is measured same-input context variation; exact cancellation must not be asserted across fresh contexts unless the actual outputs match.
exact_cancellation_negative_controls.decorrelation_counterexample: In the known-operator V2 control B=S-D_i, instantaneous B+D_i=S exactly. Replacing D_i with its history mean yields S+(meanD-D_i), destroying useful cancellation. Mature original STD0 becomes candidate0.0008185099, with gain0.850408..1.082462 and phase0.133922. This constructor-known result rejects a generic decorrelation-is-beneficial rule; it does not identify actual native covariance.
exact_cancellation_negative_controls.prior_result_limits: The V2 coefficient candidate passes strict mature STD6/6 but weak gain reaches0.938625 and full absolute detail remains0/6. The improvement does not validate a covariance model or justify retuning weak gain. V1 invalid-fallback/DC eligibility contract failure is preserved separately.

one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.name: balanced_native_diffuse_atom_impulse
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.purpose: Measure a deliberately controlled native input dependency and its spatial/temporal impulse response, separately from observed same-input context scatter. Never identify the response as noise or physical detail from that dependency alone.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.dataset_choice: One previously authenticated64-frame128x80 frozen harmonic-P trajectory, chosen before any new response is read. Use its source-only first selected canonical atom after frame8; if absent or unsupported, mark diagnostic unavailable rather than choose another scene after results.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.intervention: At frame32 only, perturb native input5 diffuse radiance RGB by +/-0.001 times the selected source-derived physical real column normalized to maxabs1, using the same fixed RGB direction[1,1,1]. Keep input5 ray-distance alpha and all other native inputs, format/upload counts and184-byte controls exactly fixed. This is an artificial native signal intervention, not a newly fitted source P or a physically certified radiance decomposition.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.validity_and_quantization: Require both prequantized signs finite and within[0,65504] for every modified pixel. If not, skip this fixed diagnostic; do not shrink amplitude or change the column after inspection. Retain actual FP16 bytes, actual odd input perturbation and even midpoint error. Nominal +/- signs need not be exactly antisymmetric after FP16 rounding. Interpret even output only alongside measured even input error, never as pure nonlinear curvature by assumption.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.bounded_contexts_if_separately_reviewed: Six fresh contexts, fixed order plus/minus/zero/zero/minus/plus,64 frames each, same pinned binary/provider/tuning/controls. No native launch is authorized or requested by this design. Caller resource/lifetime integration must be resolved independently; the impulse study is currently deferred.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.observable_statistics: Retain all individual outputs without replacing a quality candidate. Report per-frame raw RGB/alpha bit differences, spatial mean/nonDC/atom/orth response and signed odd/even response contrasts, plus within-sign/zero repeat differences. Two replicates per sign are a finite diagnostic sample, not a confidence interval or independent-noise distribution. Do not remove a context outlier, fit B-derived output or claim that a contrast exceeding one null sample is causal significance.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.causal_input_contract: Before RR authenticate all7 input trajectories and controls. Only intended frame32 input5 RGB bytes may differ; source frequency comes from past source observations. Earlier output differences across fresh contexts remain context variability, not a claimed future effect. Input upload deduplication and schedule differences must be measured and disclosed rather than silently declared equivalent.
known_operator_controls_before_any_nativ: Linear spatial operator: odd response follows actual odd perturbation; even response follows actual FP16 midpoint error. Exact algebra, not an AMD model.
Nonlinear saturating operator: an even response can be physical curvature, so it is not automatically artifact noise.
Stateful linear filter: post-impulse tail can be legitimate temporal response; absence of another visible source change does not classify it as noise.
Shared-context additive field: sign contrasts contain context confounding even with identical source/guide bytes. Balanced order does not prove independence.
Two observational worlds from the proof: their measured intervention responses remain identical although true clean detail differs. This is the mandatory failed-separability control.
Tied P=C/T(P)=B exact-cancellation control and independently repeated same-input response mismatch remain distinct. No temporal filtering may be used to make the tied identity appear cleaner.
one_deferred_counterfactual_diagnostic.metrics_and_scope: No truth-based native quality score or acceptance label is produced by this diagnostic. If known operators are scored, clean truth enters only their scorer; retain unchanged full/mature/startup/transition, strict actual STD and absolute5% gain/0.05rad phase gates. No threshold sweep or posthoc output candidate follows automatically.

Absence of a local fence is insufficient to prove an overwrite race. No native context-variance or game-stain cause is asserted.

It should compare protected-lifetime and original caller schedules under identical shader/input data, without inventing a native model effect. Parent owns this protocol; no fixture or repair is implemented here.
production_integration_cross_reference_p.game_gap: No authenticated current-alpha game water history/paired capture is available in the present packages. Historical Joint captures, the standalone fence-each-dispatch harness and synthetic known operators cannot supply current-game temporal correspondence or an accepted solution.

provenance_and_limits: This package is read-only design plus source hashes. No model edit, test execution, score sweep, GPU/native launch, game action or production integration change.
The intervention is the one optional diagnostic; no new covariance-cancel output estimator is proposed. It is deliberately not scheduled because it cannot remove the identification gap.
The separate delayed-reuse integration question is pending external caller proof and cannot be retroactively called the cause of the prior standalone same-input variance.
The stain/wave objective remains unresolved; direct control invariants can reject mistakes without proving what the clean image should be.
